data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that adds text auto-scrolling functionality for marquee text effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TextScroll widget that automatically scrolls text horizontally or vertically in endless or bouncing modes. Supports custom velocity, delays, repetition limits, styling, and text alignment.
use_when: You need to display a long string of text in a limited horizontal space using a marquee effect.
You want scrolling text with configurable bouncing or endless modes, velocities, and pauses.
avoid_when: You need standard multi-line text wrapping and layout.
You are looking for complex rich-text editors.
strengths: Supports both endless and bouncing marquee animation modes.
Highly customizable parameters like velocity, delay, and repetition counts.
Supports text styling, alignment, and selection.
weaknesses: Limited to single-purpose marquee text functionality.
Not documented for complex rich text formatting beyond standard text styles.
data.minimal_example: TextScroll('This is the sample text for Flutter TextScroll widget. ')
